text.p: OrthoLogic Corp said it purchased the Continuous Passive Motion (CPM) unit of Danninger Medical Technology Inc, for about $13 million in cash and the assumption of debt.

OrthoLogic said the Danninger CPM devices complement its own product line and that the combination should allow it "to realize certain operating and purchasing efficiencies while further enhancing the company's marketplace recognition."
Orthologic makes orthopedic devices designed to promote the healing of diseased, damaged or degenerated musculoskeletal tissue
Danninger's Cross Medical Products unit is an emerging supplier of spinal implant devices to treat degenerative conditions and deformities of the spine.
